subject.title: fix(browser): cancel Chrome MCP requests on crash

question: Should this Chrome MCP crash fix wait for live Dev Gateway plus real target-Chrome crash proof before merge, or is the current Testbox/unit evidence enough for this maintainer-labeled PR?
rationale: The code shape and dependency contract look sound, but the PR itself states live crash proof is pending and the changed behavior affects Chrome MCP session cancellation and reconnect semantics.

options.title: Wait for live crash proof
options.body: Require a redacted live run showing the request aborts, the dead MCP session is evicted, and a later browser request reconnects successfully.

options.title: Accept unit-level proof
options.body: Merge with the current focused tests and own the remaining risk that the exact target-crash path behaves differently in a real gateway session.

recommendation.title: Wait for live crash proof
recommendation.body: Require a redacted live run showing the request aborts, the dead MCP session is evicted, and a later browser request reconnects successfully.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced Chrome MCP existing-session support, authored this PR, and are the clearest owner for proof sufficiency on this path.
